en: The Sūtra on the Great Vajra Incense Dhāraṇī Spoken by the Buddha,
translated by the Tripitaka Master Śīlagupta (Shihu), Dharma Master and Acting Assistant Director of the Court of State Ceremonial,
under Imperial Decree during the Western Heaven Dynasty.
At that time, the World-Honored One spoke this great vidyā-mantra,
which is capable of subduing all devas, nakṣatras, and grahas.
This vajra-incense is of great power and supreme excellence, like a vajra-jewel;
it possesses great utility and is capable of shattering all mountains.
If there are most powerful planetary deities who do not submit, merely by reciting this Vajragandha mantra,
those celestial planets will become terrified and tremble with fear, and thus submit of their own accord.
Just as when the wind blows, the branches of a tree bend and fall in accordance with the wind,
he then spoke this dhāraṇī: *Namo ratnatrayāya, namo śākyamunaye...*
Khaṇḍavajrapāṇaye mahāyakṣasenāpate oṃ namo bhagavate ārya-vajra-gandhāriye anīka-...
Rāśmi-śatasaṃhara-prajvalite-jasaye ugrābhimānyakṣaye vikarālaye caṇḍaye jambhaya.
ākarṣaya mahāyogeśvari iṣṭapūjanakāye ṣaṭmukhaye pāvanāśabhuje dāvanāśani trāḥ.
Hakāriye vīkṣaraṇa hakāriye ani karuṇa vivadha vicitra vaiśradhara viye hyehi hi bhagavati mahāvajragandharīta.
Rātraṃ rātraṃ sātiyanā tadyathā | oṃ āgata āgata maraṇe va maheśvaraṃ garuḍa kumāraṃ mūla ||
dvikṣmaṃ indraṃ janaṃ janaṃ ānettyaṃ yakṣara-kṣasaṃ prahmaṃ dvikṣma-rakṣasaṃ agni-nyamantra-vāruṇa-vāyukuberaṃ dhanada-nam.
Dhariti-raṣṭraṃ virūḍakaṃ virūpākṣaṃ vaiśramaṇaṃ saṅku-karaṇaṃ yuga-karaṇaṃ vikaraṇaṃ mṛhaka-karaṇaṃ khaṇḍa-karaṇaṃ nṛṇa.
Karaṇasatvara karaṇamahākāraṇan nirdiśvara buriñcināya khaṃ vaya khaṃ pañci khaṃ namakhaṃ ro hakhaṃ mo hakhaṃ.
Śaṣṭhī-nirvakuṭī-giri-kāṅkāri-nu-rigakāri-taye ni mahākāri-taye caṇḍakāri-taye.
Niryaśasvin nairṛtyāṃ īśānyāṃ yakṣakali mahākali vajrakali śaṅkhakali akali vānarakali krodharāja.
